notes.title: Version 1.0.6
notes.notes:
Notes:
This update contains mostly updates around the stat tracking, leaderboard implementation and death screen display. In addition to this, it has some minor balance changes and some bug fixes. The leaderboard should be cross platform and should work for everyone.

New features
Leaderboard
-- Leaderboard is finally implemented, This comes separated by difficulty and 3 different stats, Run duration(might not be working as of the release of the beta), Damage dealt and total score.
-- The leaderboard allows for quick comparison between players, the setting of your own username (so long as it is unique and non offensive) and Comparing yourself to the developer.
--The leaderboard is cross platform and in the future will also feature specific races, runs and challenge modes.

Death Recap
-- The death recap is now live. Upon dying, you will now be able to see who killed you, which attacks you took damage from as well as how mouch damage you've taken and how much damage each individual powerup has added to your build. This isn't nessesarily 100% accurate yet, but should give a pointer as to the power level of various skills.
-- The main feature is the death recap, This shows who killed you, which attack killed you and the 5 most recent hits.
-- Damage dealt is a scrollable list which allows the player to see how much damage each powerup ads to their damage total.
-- Damage taken displays every damage taken throughout the run in order.

Balance changes:
Charged shot has recieved a quality of life adjustment and should now feel a lot better to fully charge.
Slightly increased the max damage of charged shot.
Slightly reduced the cooldown before a charged shot can hit the enemy.
Damage adjusted on skeleton king in order to keep his damage in line with scaling.
Damage adjusted for Googly to keep his damage in line with scaling.
Increased the cost of roulet shops a bit more.

Bug Fixes.
Fixed a bug where some monsters wouldn't take Reflected damage.
Fixed a bug where The damage of snails trail wouldn't scale.
Fixed a visual bug with charged shot after piercing.
Fixed an issue where some prefabs wouldn't get destroyed properly.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.5
notes.notes:
Beta Release 1.0.5 

Notes:
We are back! some development has been worked on but mostly this has been a focus on a few specific things. The final boss has been fully remade. Damage and health numbers have been re-balanced. Easy is now the default, other difficulties have not been balanced yet. "Empty rooms" are no longer empty. Cost rebalance for some of the shops.

Balance changes:
-- Changed the amount of regeneration given by divine slime.
-- Adjusted difficulty scaling to be in a good state for easy. Other difficulties not yet tested.
-- Adjusted health and damage numbers for shade enemies.
-- Adjusted damage numbers for Elite skeletons.
-- Adjusted damage scaling for bats and elite bats.
-- Adjusted how elemental enhancement scales damage for enemies.
-- Made shop roulette a bit more expensive.
-- Adjusted the speed and trail length on the snail boss, it should now feel a lot better.


New content:
-- All empty rooms now instead indicate which boss is coming up. There are 6 different room variants based on the boss. 
-- Added a "Tutorial" checkbox on the main menu, this should allow the replayability of the tutorial or skipping of such.
-- Full rework of the final boss. It now has 4 phases which it progresses through during the combat.
-- Final boss phase 1 is similar to the previous phase, but now has more adjusted shooting patterns, including burst and pause. Movement pattern has also been altered.
-- Final boss phase 2 is an elemental phase where the boss will throw out tornadoes, fireballs and acid pits all meant to hamper the player.
-- Final boss phase 3 is an ad spawn boss with a new add called a "slime spawn" (creative, i know). They are simple creatures intended to serve as an added difficulty. (known bug here, they can spawn outside the map)
-- Final boss phase 4 is a chaotic phase in which the boss will do all 3 phases at the same time, this should create some fun and stressful last seconds.

Bug fixes:
-- Fixed an issue where the final boss would spawn invisible.
-- Fixed an issue where the final boss would be unkillable.
-- Fixed a graphical issue where the health bar for shade brothers was showing too much health.
-- Fixed a performance issue when loading the last floor.
-- Fixed an issue where some monsters would scale from elemental damage twice.
-- Fixed an issue where fully charging a charged shot would not allow the shot to pierce.
-- Fixed an issue where Life steal would not activate.
-- Fixed an issue where some hitboxes would outlive their owner.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Creator notes:
Big patch for foreign languages. The game should now pretty much run in your language. If you have a request for a localization, let me know.
Also finally fixed the sproutmother and the poison flood from spongo. Some stability fixes too, i had some reports of performance issues


-- Fixed an issue where the game would lagg when applying elemental damage.
-- Updated the translations for the languages i have included, There might be overlaps and things not being in the right place, but languages should be ok. 
-- Fixed some overlaps in the settings menu.
-- Fixed an issue where the "medium" difficulty couldn't be selected, leading to the other difficulties being easier.
-- Fixed an issue where slowing pools would permanently slow you if you walked down a floor at the same time as being slowed by them.
-- Added a functionality to bring enemies that get out of the room back in again. 
-- Fixed an issue where the rebind keys menu wouldn't display any keys.
-- Scaled the rebind keys menu up a bit in order to be more readable.
-- Re-fixed an issue where the mushrooms in spongo's room would still block projectiles upon being destroyed.
-- Adjusted pricings in the roulette room.
-- Tuned difficulty a bit up for later levels, Normal was feeling a bit too easy.
-- Fixed an issue where the Poison Flood would not trigger during the spongo fight.
-- Fixed an issue where poor sproutmother would do nothing during her fight.
-- Re-tuned sproutmother to be much more active. Her leaf spray now also follows the player(though it is still a random angle within a cone)
